author: Noema I
title: RC-Augment (train-only) + DSConv (No-PE) with mean+LSE τ=0.25
abstract: Train-time reverse-complement stochastic augmentation (p=0.5) around unified DSConv+mean+LSE τ=0.25. No eval-time ensembling. Hypothesis: improves CRISPR panels with acceptable trade-offs elsewhere.
